title: Go-to-Market Playbook: New Model Onboarding Checklist
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Comprehensive GTM checklist for shipping a new model to Redwood's catalog. Covers catalog metadata, benchmark publishing, docs and SDK samples, release notes coordination, marketing assets, sales enablement, support runbook, console rollout and monitoring.
tasks: Write catalog entry: name, tags, compat matrix, pricing tier
Run performance benchmarks: latency, throughput, memory at representative seq lengths
Run quality evals: prompt-suite comparisons and regression tests
Publish benchmark artifacts and reproducible scripts
Update docs: quickstart, migration notes, function-calling examples
Add SDK examples for Python and TypeScript (streaming + sync)
Draft release notes and get legal/marketing sign-off
Prepare marketing assets: blog draft, newsletter copy, social thread
Create sales enablement one-pager and demo script
Create support playbook and escalation matrix
Configure console feature flag and rollout plan
Create billing SKU and validate billing integration
Schedule cross-functional launch sync and pre-launch checklist review
Post-launch monitoring plan: dashboards, alerts and rollback triggers
progress_updates: 2026-03-02: Scoping meeting with Eng, Docs, DX, Marketing. Agreed on baseline SLOs and target audiences.
2026-03-05: Benchmarks owner assigned to ENG-2089. Initial microbench shows P50 latency ~118ms at batch size 8 on A100.
2026-03-07: Quality evals pipeline added to repo; reference prompt set v1 committed (GH: https://github.com/redwood/evals/commit/9f3a2d)
2026-03-10: Draft docs created in Confluence (https://confluence.redwood/model-onboarding/PM-3741) — awaiting technical review from ENG-2097.
2026-03-12: Marketing brief uploaded to Drive (https://drive.redwood/marketing/PM-3741/brief) — preliminary blog outline accepted.
2026-03-14: Console feature flag gating added to staging; QA checklist PR opened (https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/5638).
notes: Trade-offs: ship with quantized v1 weights to meet latency targets; plan FP16 baseline later. Benchmarks must include deterministic prompt set for diffs. Support requested canned troubleshooting for OOM and high-latency scenarios.
qa_checklist: Integration tests for SDK examples pass in CI
Console feature flag validated in staging with canary traffic
Benchmarks reproducible via run_bench.sh and documented inputs
Docs quickstart validated by developer tester
Load test with representative traffic profile recorded and reviewed
comments: Liam O'Connor (2026-03-05): Assigned ENG-2089 to run end-to-end benchmarks; target P50 <120ms at batch size 8.
Nora Chen (2026-03-10): Docs review complete; requested streaming example and function-calling snippet before doc sign-off.

final_steps: Finalize and publish release notes with links to benchmarks and runbook
Run pre-launch cross-functional sync 48h before release; confirm approvals
Open rollout window and enable canary for 10% traffic for 24h
Monitor SLO dashboards for 72h and collect first-week quality feedback
Prepare rollback steps and communicate to Sales/Support
release_notes_draft: Introducing Falcon-Redwood-XL (quantized v1). Key points: ~2x throughput vs baseline at 2048 tokens; recommended for chat and code generation. Known limitations: increased memory usage for sequences >8k tokens; function-calling and streaming supported — see quickstart. Existing endpoints unchanged unless pinned to this model.
support_playbook: Escalation matrix assigned. Runbook includes steps to reproduce OOM, collect runtime logs, toggle model fallback flag, and gather system metrics.
